units.topic: EVOLUTION DE SYSTEMES > I. Evolution de systèmes électriques > I-1. Le condensateur, le dipôle RC
contents: Charge électrique et capacité d’un condensateur
Réponse d’un dipôle RC à un échelon de tension ; constante de temps τ = R.C

notes: Source physique3_4.pdf, pages 122-140 (p122 section cover; tables p123-126, 130, 132, 134, 136, 138, 140; commentary pages skipped). The programme is organised as A. PHYSIQUE / B. CHIMIE (used as `domain`), each split into themes printed as table titles (e.g. 'EVOLUTION DE SYSTEMES'); hours and durations dropped. Each theme is laid out as 4-column tables (Objectifs | Exemples de questionnements et d'activités | contenu | Horaire), one table per page, and each page-table has a single Objectifs cell (no row separators between units). One block = one page-table, in page order. `topic` = theme title, followed by ' > ' and the unit heading(s) of the contenu cell when the cell covers a single unit; when a cell covers several units, the unit headings are kept as items in `contents` and the objectives are not split between them (the programme does not attach them to units). Objectives are the 'Objectifs' column bullets, verbatim (sub-items kept inside their objective). Contents keep headings and '-'/'•' items in order, markers removed. Excluded: activities column, Horaire, 'Commentaires' pages, TIC footnote. Extraction fixes only: line-break hyphenation, subscripts flattened (uC(t), T0, Im, H3O+), formulas restored in plain notation: τ = L/R, λ/a, ∆E = h.ν, E = mc², MeV.c⁻², T = USm/UEm. No separate CINETIQUE CHIMIQUE table: avancement objectives sit in EQUILIBRES CHIMIQUES (p134). LES FILTRES and ONDES MECANIQUES use 1., 2., ... unit numbering instead of roman headings.
